title: Per-tool resource observation

schema.description: Protocol discriminator for the canonical per-tool resource observation.

backend.description: Collector that produced this observation. eBPF is preferred; cgroup-v2 is the dedicated fallback collector.

fallback_used.description: True when the returned observation came from the cgroup-v2 fallback after the preferred eBPF collector failed.

scope.description: Resource-accounting scope actually measured: the owned process lineage, a dedicated cgroup-v2 scope, or no measurable scope.

attribution.description: Ownership quality of the measured scope. Only exclusive_process_tree observations can supply action training labels.

unavailable_reason.description: Observation-wide reason that no primary resource observation was available. Per-metric reasons remain in metrics.

window.description: Requested and observed collection boundaries in one explicitly declared clock domain.

clock.description: Clock domain for every timestamp in this window. Values from different clock domains must not be subtracted or compared.

requested_start_ns.description: Requested window start in nanoseconds in the declared clock domain.

requested_end_ns.description: Requested window end in nanoseconds in the declared clock domain.

observed_start_ns.description: First timestamp actually covered by usable collector evidence, or null when none is known.

observed_end_ns.description: Last timestamp actually covered by usable collector evidence, or null when none is known.

coverage_ratio.description: Observed time-span coverage divided by the requested window duration, or null when it cannot be computed. This is not sampling density or metric eligibility.

max_sample_gap_ns.description: Largest edge or inter-sample gap in nanoseconds used by the observation-level coverage check.

complete.description: Whether collector evidence covers the requested window under the current completeness checks. Individual metrics can still be ineligible.

late_scope_binding.description: True when the authoritative resource scope became known only after collection began; available values are then withheld from training.

action_clock_unusable.description: True when action boundaries could not be safely aligned with the collector clock; available values are then withheld from action training.

kind.description: Meaning of the requested window: action hook boundaries, the fallback collector's own window, or finalized execution telemetry boundaries. Omitted on older action observations.

metrics.description: Per-metric values and independent availability and training-eligibility decisions.

cpu_time.description: Cumulative CPU time and, when action-window eligible, average cores.

cpu_peak.description: Maximum fixed-window CPU utilization, expressed as cores. The current measurement window is 500 ms.

memory_peak.description: Peak sampled distinct-mm RSS for the owned process lineage. This is separate from environment memory and cgroup memory charge.

disk_io.description: Read and write byte deltas from task I/O accounting over the metric window.

network_io.description: Received and transmitted byte deltas when a supported network collector is available; currently unavailable for finalized execution telemetry.

memory_charge_peak.description: Optional absolute cgroup memory.peak charge observed by fallback. It is neither RSS nor a delta and is never an action training label.

loss.description: Observation-window eBPF loss counters. Any positive loss makes the primary observation unavailable.

execution_telemetry_quality.description: Quality status copied from finalized execution telemetry when kind is execution.

fallback_reason.description: Failure reason from the preferred eBPF observation when a cgroup-v2 fallback observation is returned.

available.description: Whether this metric has a measured value for its stated measurement and window.

eligible.description: Whether the metric is safe to use as a complete, exclusively attributed action training label. Availability alone is insufficient.

reason.description: Metric-specific eligibility or unavailability reason; ok means the metric is eligible.

measurement.description: Stable identifier for the measurement method and semantic definition used for this metric.

value_seconds.description: Cumulative CPU time in core-seconds; used only by cpu_time.

average_cores.description: Average occupied CPU cores over a complete action window; used only by cpu_time.

value_cores.description: Fixed-window CPU utilization in cores; used only by cpu_peak.

value_bytes.description: Byte value for memory_peak or memory_charge_peak, interpreted according to measurement.

read_bytes.description: Read or receive byte delta for disk_io or network_io.

write_bytes.description: Write or transmit byte delta for disk_io or network_io.

window_ms.description: Fixed aggregation window in milliseconds; currently 500 for cpu_peak.

sample_count.description: Number of contributing samples when the collector exposes one; null means the count is not available.

counter_exact.description: Whether value_bytes is an exact counter rather than a sampled peak. False for sampled RSS.

window_start_ns.description: Metric-specific collector-window start in the observation clock domain when it differs from the requested window.

window_end_ns.description: Metric-specific collector-window end in the observation clock domain when it differs from the requested window.

description: eBPF-preferred tool observations. Dedicated cgroup fallback records its own collector window and never substitutes memory charge for RSS. Eligibility is metric-specific.
